title: nan
authors: Zhang X.; Li T.; Wang Z.; Kuang Y.
key_contribution: Presents a novel scene-matching positioning approach for low-altitude UAVs in GNSS-denied urban environments using HMM retrieval, elevation-difference pose recovery, and factor graph optimization.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
